contract: Bounded immutable full-prefix checkpoints and fail-closed recovery through the Store boundary; preserves model, complete cursor and identity witnesses.
limits: Size grows O(applied) with the seen index; oversize snapshots are refused, not truncated.
Storage guarantees are inherited from the supplied Store; no disk durability, exactly-once or universal refold-equivalence proof.
Readers never repair or mutate storage. A damaged snapshot cannot anchor retention; pruned recovery without an anchor fails closed.
Fallback after an invalid latest checkpoint probes earlier sequences one read at a time; cost grows with the gap (no indexed predecessor lookup).

grounding.claim: Finite take/recover, version/digest fallback, complete-seed preservation, checkpoint_too_large, terminal damage, pruned recovery and reader-write audit scenarios.
Elixir validation, exceptions and BEAM execution are upstream contracts, not proved here.
OTP 29.1.2 GenServer, process lifecycle and crypto APIs are upstream contracts; no disk durability or exactly-once guarantee.
The consumer supplies deterministic matching encode/decode functions and fold version; provider persistence/configuration remain external.

telemetry.contract: Callable checkpoint boundary; no events or independent instrumentation lifecycle.

config.contract: Per-call fold_version and model codec; store snapshot form carries max_checkpoint_bytes.

control.contract: No independent runtime lifecycle to pause, drain or resume.
